title: Tasty Kitchen A-Z
hook: Notice the property before naming the picture.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: bright 3D tasty-kitchen storybook, fresh food colors, friendly cookware, clean high-contrast composition

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child observing sensory properties safely
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: property cue -> recall beat -> target -> air-shape gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a glockenspiel shape-ping followed by one muted woodblock answer.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a glockenspiel shape-ping followed by one muted woodblock answer
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Tasty Kitchen A-Z a sensory-food-science gallery: shape, texture, aroma, state and tool mechanics are observed without tasting commands or generic 'yummy' judgments.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child compares crisp/soft, liquid/solid, citrus aroma, vanilla aroma, grid/spiral shapes and mechanical mixing from pictures.
